Production entry/SL/TP2 are frozen at episode start; after TP1 the remaining position is protected at breakeven for canonical paper-performance accounting; public provider chain; first 5m touch, 1m refinement for same-5m ambiguity; excursions stop at terminal first-touch; expired positions marked to market at 12h.

scope_semantics.execution_ready_shadow: PRODUCTION_QUALIFIED AND execution_ready_at_capture=true; MODELLED PATH, NOT A FILL

Conditional/non-executable plans remain research evidence but are excluded from executable performance. Production entry/SL/TP2 are frozen at episode start; after TP1 the remaining position is protected at breakeven for canonical paper-performance accounting; public provider chain; first 5m touch, 1m refinement for same-5m ambiguity; excursions stop at terminal first-touch; expired positions marked to market at 12h.

Production entry/SL/TP2 are frozen at episode start; after TP1 the remaining position is protected at breakeven for canonical paper-performance accounting; public provider chain; first 5m touch, 1m refinement for same-5m ambiguity; excursions stop at terminal first-touch; expired positions marked to market at 12h.

scope_semantics.execution_ready_shadow: PRODUCTION_QUALIFIED AND execution_ready_at_capture=true; MODELLED PATH, NOT A FILL
